messages:
Lina (PS): Nimbus flagged missing hourly spikes after we switched to minute ingestion. They think entitlement activations (~5-10m lag) cause misattribution. quick sync?

Theo (Infra): Can repro in logs. Our hourly bucketing floors timestamps so late entitlements get dropped from the expected hour. Need a reconciliation plan.

Ravi (Billing): Suggest idempotent ingest by event_id + a 15m entitlement grace when computing hourly aggregates. Also need an adjustments policy for credits.

Sam (Eng): Proposed minimal playbook: partner resends minute events, we upsert raw_events, backfill hourly aggregates, emit adjustment records with provenance.

Theo (Infra): Field mismatch too: Nimbus uses `acctId` vs our `tenant_id`. I'll add partner mapping in translation layer.

Ravi (Billing): Auto-credit rule: apply adjustments <=100 token-equivalent and <24h automatically, otherwise route to ops review. Show all adjustments in Billing -> Adjustments.

marketplace-bot: Planned change: enable streaming-aggregator for partner:nimbus on 2024-11-12T02:00:00Z.

Lina (PS): I'll share the replay checklist and confirm Nimbus will replay minute CSVs. Please flag any gaps. :thumbsup:
